definitions.explanation: The legal right to possess, use, and dispose of property. A fundamental concept in law covering both physical property and intellectual property.

examples.japanese: この{土地|とち}の{所有権|しょゆうけん}は{誰|だれ}にあるのか。
{所有権|しょゆうけん}を{移転|いてん}する{手続|てつづ}きが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A procedure to transfer ownership is necessary.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}の{所有権|しょゆうけん}は{登記|とうき}によって{公示|こうじ}される。
examples.english: Real estate ownership is made public through registration.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term, but also used in everyday contexts when discussing property, cars, and belongings. In Japanese law, {所有権|しょゆうけん} is one of the most fundamental property rights.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}を{持|も}つ (to have ownership)
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}を{移転|いてん}する (to transfer ownership)
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}を{主張|しゅちょう}する (to claim ownership)
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}{放棄|ほうき} (abandonment of ownership)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {所有|しょゆう}: ownership, possession — the act or state of owning, without the legal-rights nuance
- {著作権|ちょさくけん}: copyright — specifically for creative works
